svg.title: Warden Barracks — Drill court & bunk loft
svg.desc: The recruit court remains open beneath bunks and equipment galleries. Shield racks and footlockers make low jump steps toward the captain balcony. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops
